abstract: Endometriosis coexisting with a dermoid cyst of the ovary is extraordinarily rare, although both these benign conditions are said to be common in women in the reproductive age group. There are only two previous case reports,which is evident from our literature review from January 1960 through January 2010. Acute abdomen is one of the greatest diagnostic challenges and easily ignored by the clinicians to exclude the possibility of gynecologic illness. A 35-year-old woman was referred by the doctor in Family clinic. She experienced a three-day period of severe right lower abdominal pain and intermittent vomiting. Ultrasonography identified a bilocular, cystic, hypoechoic, and hyperechoic tumor, 7 cm × 6 cm × 6 cm in the right adnexal region. Laparoscopic cystectomy was performed under the impression of ovarian cyst with torsion or hemorrhage. The frozen section was benign and appendiceal status was adequate. Histopathologic examination described an ovarian cyst composed of endometrial-type lining with stromacells (endometriosis) and benign teratoma tissue with plenty of skin appendages and sebaceous glands. We report this unusual and interesting ovarian mass to remind physicians that the usage of the Endobag after cystectomy, the benefits on minimizing operative time, spilled opportunity, and postoperative complications. Laparoscopic techniques for large ovarian masses might be considered. The experience of the surgeon is also very important to prevent misdiagnosis or complication. Further follow up is mandatory for this simultaneous finding of ovarian endometriosis with coincidental dermoid cyst as a separate pathology in single ovary of such a nature. It also presents a challenge to the clinicians and to the pathologists.
abstract_ja: 卵巣の類皮嚢腫と子宮内膜症の併存は極めてまれであるが、いずれも生殖年齢の女性に多い良性疾患とされる。文献検索（1960年1月〜2010年1月）では、これまで2報の症例報告しか見当たらない。急性腹症は診断上の大きな課題であり、婦人科疾患の除外が見落とされやすい。35歳女性が家庭医より紹介された。3日間の強い右下腹部痛と間歇的な嘔吐を訴えていた。超音波検査で右付属器領域に7×6×6 cmの二房性・嚢胞性で低エコー性と高エコー性の混在する腫瘍を認めた。卵巣嚢腫の捻転または出血の疑いで腹腔鏡下嚢胞摘出術を施行した。術中迅速診断は良性であり、虫垂の所見も問題なかった。組織病理学的検査では、子宮内膜型の内張りと間質細胞を有する卵巣嚢胞（子宮内膜症）と、皮膚付属器および皮脂腺を豊富に含む良性奇形腫組織が認められた。本稿では、この珍しく興味深い卵巣腫瘤を報告し、嚢胞摘出後のEndobag使用の利点（手術時間の短縮、腫瘍内容の漏出の機会の減少、術後合併症の低減）を述べる。大きな卵巣腫瘤に対する腹腔鏡手術も検討に値する。医師の経験は誤診や合併症の防止に非常に重要である。このような単一卵巣における卵巣子宮内膜症と偶発的な類皮嚢腫の併存は、別個の病変として今後のフォローアップが必須である。臨床医および病理医にとっても課題となる。
